name: web-dark-pricing-grid-with-mono-prices-and-check-lists
title: Black 'Data-Driven Growth' pricing with four bordered plans in a wide-and-narrow grid, monospace prices and check lists
whatItIs: A near-black page with a big white heading and grey paragraph above four bordered dark cards in a bento arrangement: a wide Creators Special card with a 'Most Recommended' tag, a light Subscribe button, $19/month in monospace and four checked features; Starters $0, Teams $49 and Enterprise $99 each with a small tag, a dark Subscribe button and check lists.
whatItMeans: Technical and calm; monospace prices and outlined cards feel like a developer product.
techniques: Highlight the recommended plan with a light button.
Use a wide card for the featured tier.

vocabulary.definition: A price set in a fixed-width typeface.
The recommended plan given more space.
Feature lines marked with tick circles.
A small pill naming a tier.
